title: the update's code comes from the signed new bundle
note: basis 'shown' means shown by the card's local runs (the real apply_update.sh and signer, a stand-in docker); the bench host, Docker and the box rehearsal were not run.

findings.claim: caller environment variables steer the update's trust: TB_VENDOR_PUBKEY names the key a signature is checked against on a box without trust.json, and TB_VERIFY_IN_DOCKER with TB_PY_IMAGE make a caller-chosen image run the verifier (tools/apply_update.sh); deploy/install.sh reads TB_VENDOR_PUBKEY too
findings.fix: H-124 (the integrator's ruling 7131272906): the key is the installed key file alone (a file of its own, root's or this user's), the verifier's image settings are deploy/.env's, a caller's three variables are unset unread; deploy/gcp/demo-vm-update.sh and install.sh line 406 are outside this card

findings.claim: only a box whose installed apply_update.sh has H-124 runs the new release's update code; a box on an older release runs its own update code once more (the walk box's red), so such a box needs H-124 installed first
findings.fix: not in this card: the release note says it; H-123's rehearsal from release N-1 shows it

findings.claim: host_tree._unpack writes a release folder (and the update's staged code) to .partial and renames it, without fsync of the files or the folder; a power cut after the rename may leave short files in releases/<id>
findings.fix: the third commit of H-124: fsync of each file, each folder and the parent after the rename (test_h124_03_an_unpacked_tree_is_on_disk_before_it_is_named)

findings.claim: not run on the bench host, with Docker or in the box rehearsal: the hand-off ran with the real apply_update.sh, the real verifier and signer and a stand-in docker
findings.fix: the rehearsal job on its pull request; H-123's update from release N-1

findings.claim: the ruling's PRODUCTION refusal of a bundle without a host tree would also refuse every signed model pack (H-95: images and weights only, no code by design); built as an exception that runs the installed code and says so, for the integrator to confirm
